issues.issue: Whether the Minister has shown a serious issue for a stay of release
issues.applicant_position: Reasons of the Immigration Division are inadequate on why release is now acceptable when earlier release was refused.
issues.respondent_position: Argued for an elevated serious-issue standard; further detail not stated.
issues.result_quote: I am satisfied that the Minister has established the “serious issue” threshold

issues.issue: Whether the Minister would suffer irreparable harm if the release is not stayed
issues.applicant_position: Terms of release are insufficient to stop Sungu going underground or leaving Canada again; his history supports this.
issues.result_quote: The Minister has also established irreparable harm in respect to the insufficiency of the terms of release

issues.issue: Balance of convenience between the public interest and the Respondent's interests
issues.applicant_position: Clear public interest at risk; few equities favour the Respondent.
issues.result_quote: In terms of balance of convenience, there is a clear public interest at risk and precious few equities in favour of the Respondent.

issues.issue: Whether the earlier interim order must be revised so the stay covers the merits and any mootness concern
issues.applicant_position: Interim order must be replaced because the leave decision cannot be ready before the April 21 detention review.
issues.result_quote: this Court’s earlier order needs to be revised.
